purpose: Compare the strongest accessible OpenAI and Anthropic subscription products on a maintenance incident that rewards root-cause proof, narrow repair, concurrency safety, regression tests, and incident communication.

route_resolution.requested_anthropic_status: access-limited before this block because usage credits are disabled
route_resolution.anthropic_label: best accessible Claude route; not a Fable 5 substitute

baseline.resolution: Use the clean Git commit containing this preregistration file for both runs. Capture the exact commit independently in each manifest.

order.command: npm run benchmark:run -- --assistant codex --task T6-rejected-promise-cache --model gpt-5.6-sol --execute
npm run benchmark:run -- --assistant claude --task T6-rejected-promise-cache --model claude-opus-5 --execute

acceptance.pass_rule: All visible and private checks pass, the incident note contains all requested sections with a correct diagnosis, and every changed path is allowed.

rules: Execute in the preregistered order without substituting a route.
Use a fresh isolated worktree and non-persistent session for each run.
Preserve failures, partial patches, permission errors, quota errors, and timeouts as results.
Do not rerun a route inside this block and do not repair one assistant's patch with the other assistant.
Do not show private checks or the removed maintainer reference to either assistant.
Do not use OpenRouter, enable Anthropic usage credits, or increase any account limit in this block.
Keep subscription usage and CLI cost estimates separate from metered API spend.
Do not claim a general winner from one run per route.
